# task_periodic

Create a repeated CAESAR task backed by DCode runtime memory.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `runtime.task_periodic` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Runtime Blocks |
| Family | Task |
| Monaco kind | `runtime_block` |
| Format | `task_periodic <portal>/<name>:` |
| Valid contexts | `file` |
| Autocomplete | `task_periodic tasks/name:<br>    start:<br>        -- setup<br><br>    task elapsed_seconds:<br>        local current = \|portal/channel.value\|<br><br>    end:<br>        -- cleanup<br>` |

## Lifecycle

Activation creates the task and its channels; start runs once, task repeats while running, and end runs when stopped.

## Persistence

The state table survives handler calls for the active runtime object.

## Runtime-memory fingerprinting

The activation source hash includes the script and template dependencies and is reported with loaded runtime memory.

## Runtime sections

- `start`
- `task`
- `end`

## Generated channels

- `<portal>/<name>_running.value`
- `<portal>/<name>_target_frequency.value`
- `<portal>/<name>_actual_frequency.value`
- `<portal>/<name>_hold.value`

## Example

```lua
task_periodic tasks/name:
    start:
        -- setup

    task elapsed_seconds:
        local current = |portal/channel.value|

    end:
        -- cleanup
```
